caption: The drawing consists of a square composition bordered by a thin red and black outline, filled with geometric floral and leaf motifs on a beige background. Inside, there are three large, stylized, red flowers with five-pointed petals, each incorporating triangular segments that are a lighter blue, decorated with yellow flourishes and floral patterns. Spread across the composition are curving vine-like lines shaded in blue and decorated with small, blue leaves that also have yellow and black linear embellishments. The left and bottom sides feature a series of repeating red triangles with yellow designs, forming a sawtooth or flight-like pattern, which runs parallel to the edges of the square and separates the vine motif from the geometric floral elements. The layout is symmetrical and divided into distinct sections by these repeated geometric shapes and curvilinear lines.
title: Quilt (Corner)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
